representation: frozen bert-base-uncased token-level last hidden state [128, 768]
predictor: 3-layer 1D CNN 768-256-128-64, kernel 3, dropout 0.2 after first block, masked global max pool, MLP head 64-32-1, Softplus output

epochs.selection: 5-fold CV on the source pool; final epochs = mean of fold best epochs, clipped to [1, 25]

protocol: per-source training, target held out from training and selection
